posts.post_subject: Hello and I have a transport not sure if it’s Motion or 70mm. Still
posts.content_md: It's a vintage film transport from the 1970s used to make holograms in an industrial environment. Quite obsolete. Film for it not made in decades. I'd be interested if you ever want to sell it, for display with similar old holography and laser equipment. There are much easier and cheaper ways to do similar technical holography using modern cameras. This is a wonderful relic of days long past.
